(MASK U021 P45–169,276–350.)

When companions face a curse, her intervention is costly. Her attempted final spell is not completed; offering her soul, the price refused by Vanir, the alternative technique, available foresight he does not use, and the later report of recovery remain separate acts and accounts. The narrative does not supply a safe, freely chosen solution to every participant at every moment. Wiz actually freezes Hans and the contaminated spring, then states her neutrality condition: it applies to those who do not kill humans outside combat roles. She expressly distinguishes adventurers and knights, whose work includes reciprocal lethal risk, from the uninvolved manager.
